newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Promstroibank St Petersburg plans 3-5 yr Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Promstroibank St Petersburg plans 3-5 yr Eurobond.

text.p: One of Russia's biggest banks, Promstroibank St Petersburg, said on Thursday it plans to issue up to $50 million of three to five year Eurobonds in 1997 through CS First Boston.
"An agreement in principle with the chief organiser of the issue, CS First Boston investment bank, will allow us to bring our bonds to market," Promstroibank said in a statement.
The Eurobonds will be denominated in dollars and placed mainly with European investors, OAO Promyshlenno-Stroitelny Bank Sankt-Peterburg (Promstroibank) said.
It said the semi-annual interest would be tied to the LIBOR rate.
Promstroibank St Petersburg is not connected to another big Russian bank, Promstroibank.
